dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Single high-contrast white horizontal band across the greater coverts, approximately 2-4 pixels thick, sharply defined against the blue-gray wing ground color.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent pale white edges with sharp boundaries along the length of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, roughly trapezoidal pale yellow-green patch located on the dorsal midline of the neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct and linear boundary separating the black crown/nape from the greenish-gray mantle, interrupted centrally by a pale nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white auricular patch completely enclosed by black plumage.
